text:
alice: quick sync — we need a pragmatic deprecation + customer-transition plan for models that fail perf/accuracy post-quant. goal: minimize customer surprise, provide opt-in migration credits, and define clear launch/retire gates.
ben: +1. propose staggered windows by tenant size: small (<10k qps) get 30d notice, med 60d, large custom.
carla: benchmarks must include: latency p95 suite, embed cosine stability (sample set), hallucination regression on 10 golden prompts. we should version these tests.
dan: cs input — customers want an automated opt-out for auto-migration and a human-reviewed exception lane. also offering migration credits will help adoption.
eva: ops note — need routing fallback policy: when primary model is retired, route to pinned fallback with same API surface. add a monitor that flags token-cost deltas >20%.
alice: launch gate checklist draft: 1) benchmark pass on canary cohort 2) migration tool docs 3) comms template + migration-credit clause 4) runtime fallback verified in staging.
ben: technical: add a canary with 5% traffic for 7 days, collect quality delta and perf regressions. if quality drop >2% on golden set -> rollback.
carla: define golden set curation owner — @carla. also: define automated scoring: BLEU/ROUGE/embedding-sim thresholds + human spot checks for edge cases.
dan: comms: draft customer email + in-console banner. propose a two-touch cadence: 60d notice, 30d reminder, 7d final. include migration window and credits link.
eva: infra ask: add a boolean flag in model-catalog metadata: "auto_migrate_allowed" and "migration_credit_amount" so billing can apply credits automatically.
alice: policy decision: default opt-in for auto-migrate for new small tenants, opt-out button for enterprise. we need legal sign-off on credits.
ben: implementation notes: endpoint change minimal — keep model id same but alias to new backend; enforce semantic version pinning for customers who opt-out. add a rollout flag: "soft_deprecate" that flips traffic routing.
carla: evaluation timeline: canary baseline -> day 3 check -> day 7 quality review. store all canary responses in a cohort bucket for replay tests.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: model-catalog-service@staging updated with schema v2.3, migration flags.
dan: ops/comms overlap — can we automate generating a migration plan per tenant? even a stub would help CSMs.
eva: yes, we can compile: current model usage, most used prompts, cost delta estimate, and suggested timeline. should be a new endpoint /tenant_migration_plan.
alice: owners: carla for benchmarks, ben for runtime/fallback, eva for infra schema + endpoint, dan for comms/customer ops. meet again Friday 10am to review the first draft checklist. :calendar:
